name: arest-mcp-registry
description: The MCP router's own store: which apps it serves, where each package is, and whether to start it, read when the router starts. What an app's check compiles is its package.json's dependencies. There is no `mcp` script: nothing calls a verb on the registry, so it composes no module and starts no server. There is no `check` script either: a check is lambda's apps_check, which the router runs itself.
